title: Rabbi Aftoriki
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: His father’s name was Dostai. Hyman says that the father was always designated by his son, or simply “the father of Rabbi Aftoriki”; in Chullin 64b: “Dostai, the father of Rabbi Aftoriki.” Hyman explains this by saying that the father only recited baraitot and the son was better known, so the father is mentioned by his son’s name. Rabbi Aftoriki is mentioned in halakhic matters in Zevachim 12a and Menachot 55b.

notes.text: Dostai is the father designated by his better-known son. The Zevachim and Menachot halakhic mentions concern Rabbi Aftoriki. The role distinction and Hyman’s “always” assertion remain explicit.

Chullin 64b explicitly calls Dostai the father of Rabbi Aftoriki. The explanation of their relative prominence is Hyman’s; this locus does not independently establish the father’s entire teaching role.
